comparison.objective: Carry a generator to a safe distance and orient its exhaust away from a house; candidate commissions an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object transport and orientation versus small-tool alignment, bimanual counterholding, precision rotation, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Generator at scaled 20-foot distance with exhaust facing away versus two dynamically safe stops and verified retention.
comparison.reason: Different scale, mechanism, and tested ability. No spec versions were provided, though the body includes the main distance and orientation scoring.
